column2: Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this Act  and  any  other

column1: written law, the Corporation shall, have the power—

column2: to acquire, hold and develop any property movable
or  immovable  which  may  become  vested  in  it  by
virtue  of  any  purchase,  grant,  gift,  testamentary
disposition or otherwise ;
to  sell,  mortgage,  lease,  exchange  or  otherwise
dispose of any such property ;

to 
appoint, 
employ, 
remunerate, 
exercise
disciplinary control over and dismiss officers and
servants as may be necessary for the purposes of the
Corporation  ;
to receive grants, gifts or donations in cash or kind
whether from local or foreign sources ;
to  establish  branches  of  the  Corporation  in  any
foreign country for the purpose of carrying out the
objects of the Corporation ;
to  open,  operate  and  close  bank  accounts  and  to
borrow  or  raise  money  with  the  property  of  the
corporation as security or without such security for
the purposes of the Corporation ;
